Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the chronological relationship between the two birth dates. It stated that "1961 is later than 1941, so Jerry Glanville is younger," which is logically false. In chronological terms, a later birth year (1961) means the person is older, while an earlier birth year (1941) means the person is younger. The Planner failed to apply the correct logic that "younger" corresponds to the more recent date, leading to the wrong final conclusion that Jerry Glanville is younger when Keith Bostic is actually the younger of the two.
